name: oge-athena
description: Read-only OGENIC Athena access to staging runtime provenance, D1 health, declared permissions, integration bindings, and owner-main 1LSS session references.

interface.shortDescription: Read OGENIC runtime, permissions, and sessions
interface.longDescription: A read-only, evidence-first bridge for OGENIC WAVE. It separates configured status from verified access and keeps all consequential execution behind Yellow Stone and Owner approval.
defaultPrompt: Use OGE Athena to inspect the current OGENIC staging runtime, D1 query health, declared permissions, integration bindings, and owner-main session references. Distinguish observations from unverified claims.
